summary: There's a part of you that knows a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control flow together so easily you can take it for granted. It comes naturally — you think for yourself and break the mold and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people — which is exactly why it's easy to coast on.
body: There's a part of you that knows a need to be free and no patience for being boxed in and an intensity you can't fake and a pull toward control flow together so easily you can take it for granted. gift: At your best: you think for yourself and break the mold, and you go deep and survive what would flatten other people.
shadow: The trap: you blow things up just to feel free, or you feel out of control — or you grip too hard, test people, or burn it down before it can leave you.
integration: Let freedom and disruption and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Transformative, disruptive, generational themes.
do: Use it on purpose, not on reflex
Let you think for yourself and you go deep work together
When it spikes, name it before you act
dont: You blow things up just to feel free
Let the reflex make the decision
